title: The square root of 2 broke a Greek worldview
body: Pythagoreans built philosophy on ratios of whole numbers, then proved a unit square's diagonal cannot be one: if sqrt(2) were p/q in lowest terms, both p and q would be even, forever. The contradiction style of that proof became mathematics' standard weapon. Legend says Hippasus was drowned for it; the legend is likely invented, the proof is not.
